jamie: PTAL — addressed all review comments on PR #1243. Switched to snapshot tests, added smoke, fixed the allocator flake we saw. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1243
olivia: scanning now, thanks! did you run the e2e smoke locally?
jamie: yes, ran `make smoke` and a short staging run. logs looked clean. here's the failing snippet I fixed:
```
- if (kv == NULL) crash;
+ if (kv == nullptr) return Err(...);
```
nithin: nice. can we get a quick perf run before canary? last change touched batching paths.
sam: agree — if perf stable we can slot this into today's canary (3pm PT).
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed — unit(✓), integration(✓), lint(✓). artifacts: https://ci.redwood/inference/1234
olivia: quick diff check, lgtm with one nit about a comment, not a blocker. :thumbsup:
jamie: addressed the comment and force-pushed, PTAL again. I did not squash, prefer a single fixup commit.
nithin: I'll run the perf job against staging in ~20m and post numbers.
sam: can someone reserve the 3pm canary slot? otherwise we wait for tomorrow.
olivia: I can take 3pm slot if perf looks ok, ping me once nithin posts results.
ci-bot: deploy-preview ready at https://deploy-preview.redwood/inference/1243
